summary: Create an ECMAScript RegExp from a pattern and flags without translating the pattern to .NET regex syntax.

target.notes: The runtime must parse ECMAScript RegExp grammar, validate flags, preserve original source/flags, and create mutable lastIndex state.

caveats: ECMAScript escapes, Unicode modes, character classes, backreferences, lookarounds, and case folding differ from .NET.
Flags are d,g,i,m,s,u,v,y; duplicates and invalid combinations throw SyntaxError.
